LOOK: Members of fisherfolk group PAMALAKAYA held a fluvial action off the coast of Navotas City today, January 15, 2026, in protest of ongoing dump-and-fill operations in the area. 

Local fishers and residents suspect this is connected to the 650-hectare Navotas Coastal Bay Reclamation Project of San Miguel Corporation and the Navotas local government. 

“This will only worsen flooding in Navotas and in other parts of Manila. This also threatens the homes livelihoods of fisherfolk in the city,” states Romel Escarial, president of PAMALAKAYA-Navotas.

Photos courtesy of PAMALAKAYA
